TC-22/S20.productIssue: Nursing Home Post-Round task toggles have no name and no state; both Task Export screens use 'Mark task done' / 'Undo — move back to pending' without the task text and without aria-pressed — a screen-reader user hears the same label for every task and cannot tell which is done (oracle predicted exactly this Fail, WCAG 4.1.2).
